description: Identity and status of a connected Discord bot: bot user, application, guild count, enabled gateway intents, and the Omnicord version. With more than one bot configured, pass bot to pick which (list_servers shows the configured bots). Use run_setup_check for a full health check with fix instructions.

bot.description: Which bot to act as, by name, when more than one is configured. Omit to use the default bot.

name: get_bot_info
title: Get bot info
